shadows.purpose: Overlays and floating menus; light mode uses a softer ink shadow.

components.name: Brand lockup
components.description: Theme-aware Memory Ribbon symbol paired with the Memex wordmark.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #E9EEF6; font: 600 20px/1.2 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-brand img { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: none; }

narrative.northStar: Connected memory, kept in your hands.
narrative.overview: Memex is a self-hosted Personal Knowledge OS. Its continuous folded ribbon forms an abstract M: capture and recall are joined through one clear crease. The UI uses dark graphite and light porcelain surfaces, restrained iris and jade accents, a 4px spacing rhythm, 6–16px component radii, clear focus, and reduced-motion support.
keyCharacteristics: Grounded in capture, connection, and recall

rules.name: One folded ribbon
rules.body: Keep the M as one continuous rounded stroke with a single inner fold; do not add effects or decorative framing.

rules.name: Theme-correct mark
rules.body: Use the light iris/jade pair on dark surfaces and the dark iris/jade pair on light surfaces; use a single inherited color for monochrome contexts.

dos: Use approved light, dark, and monochrome variants.
Preserve the mark's proportions and fold detail.
donts: Do not use the plain M tile as the final logo.
Do not invent product or privacy claims in brand materials.
